notes: SCMD_VERSION sends "Dark Pawns 2.3-" plus SVN_REVISION, which is empty, to every level; the port used to append an invented Go build line here (R1/R4/R5e).

The immortal arm prints "Compile Time: %s" from load_compile_time()'s boot stamp in local time as "Month D, YYYY   HH:MM"; the overlapping sprintf is UB, so the port renders the intended bytes (R1a). The stamp is each engine's own boot wall clock, so the line is byte-equal while both boots share a minute.
SCMD_VERSION never inspects its argument, so "version ignored-argument" prints the same two lines (R1/R2).
